feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag umasa lamang sa pulso kung hindi sanay. Huwag mag-compression sa totoong tao. Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata.
feedback_by_option.en: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not use a pulse check as the only gate for an untrained rescuer, practise compressions on a live person, or treat the old CAB paragraph as certification.

feedback_by_option.fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.
Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis.
feedback_by_option.en: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis.

feedback_by_option.fil: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag umasa lamang sa pulso kung hindi sanay. Huwag mag-compression sa totoong tao. Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata.
feedback_by_option.en: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not use a pulse check as the only gate for an untrained rescuer, practise compressions on a live person, or treat the old CAB paragraph as certification.

feedback_by_option.fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
feedback_by_option.en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.
